description: Sets one voltage and shows it at the same time as volts, VCO frequency, LFO frequency, LFO tempo, note name and cents

inputs.text: Overwrites the knob with the voltage patched here, turning the module into a meter that reads that voltage in all six forms

outputs.text: Carries the voltage set by the knob, or the voltage at IN while something is patched there

notes: a value typed into any of the text fields sets the voltage: VOLTS, HZ, LFO HZ, LFO BPM and NOTE all write to the same one, and Command-A or Ctrl-A selects a whole field.
HZ reads the voltage as a VCO pitch, with 0V giving C4 at 261.63Hz; LFO HZ reads the same voltage as an LFO rate, with 0V giving 2Hz.
NOTE takes names like C4, F#2 or Ab0, and negative octaves such as C-2; a flat is shown back as the equivalent sharp.
the cents field shows how far the voltage is from the nearest exact semitone.
